palette: #5A4FCF deep purple-indigo (night sky, street, large bg fields); #F5A623 warm yellow-orange (characters' shirts, burger bun, string lights); #E23B3B saturated red (caps, gift boxes, balloon, signage accents); #2E8B8B teal (restaurant trim, countertops, aprons, clock); #FFE9B8 cream/pale yellow (interior walls, counters, caption text areas); #FCD34D golden yellow with dark outline (all chant captions); #6B3F2B warm brown (wood counters, floors, brick); #F2C9A0 skin tone (character heads, hands)
color_arc: Opens cool dark purple night party -> cuts to bright teal/cream daytime storefront -> warm tan/yellow close-up interior sequence -> cream/teal gift finale -> returns to purple night celebration with lights -> ends warm brown/tan interior close-up. So the arc oscillates night-purple <-> day-teal-cream, bookended by night, ending on warm close-up energy
caption_style: One single word per frame, lowercase (except HUSS!, Thank-you card), bold rounded sans (Balloony/Nunito-like), golden yellow #FCD34D fill with thick dark-brown/black outline (~8-10% of cap height), soft drop shadow; height ~6-8% of frame; anchored lower-center at ~75-85% frame height; reads as rhythmic karaoke-style word-per-beat; final frame replaces chant with a white rounded speech-bubble card holding 3 stacked black lines
character_staging: Alternating wide party shots (6-12 blocky townsfolk filling street) and extreme close-ups: heads/arms occupy 60-90% of frame, cropped at edges, torso-up, facing camera front-on or 3/4; characters are simple geometric silhouettes with minimal facial detail (dot eyes, straight mouths, simple mustache/hair shapes); key emotion beats (angry red-cap worker) get the tightest crops
camera: Mostly static locked frames; implied push-in on the burger (Frame 9 huge, Frame 10 medium = pull-back/reveal of mustache customer); cuts are the energy, not moves — hard cut per word, occasional slight dolly-in implied on repeated HUSS frames
lighting: Night frames: warm point glows from string lights and lanterns (small bright halos, ~8-14px bloom), moderate contrast, saturated purple ambient; day frames: flat soft ambient, minimal shadow, no glow; interiors evenly lit with no cast shadows — overall high-saturation, medium-contrast toy-box lighting
huss_treatment: HUSS! appears twice (frames 6 and 12): identical treatment — bold all-caps yellow with heavy dark outline, ~8% frame height, lower-center, slight italic/skew implying a shout, paired with extreme close-up of clenched arms/hands slamming frame edges; no repetition-within-frame, distortion is minimal (just a shake/zoom jitter implied between occurrences)
empty_vs_dense: Party/night frames ~70% dense (crowd, lights, houses fill frame); close-up frames inverted: ~50-65% empty flat tan/cream background with one object centered; final speech-bubble frame ~70% empty pale background. Rhythm = dense establishing -> sparse punchline
the_5_things: 1) One-word yellow-outlined caption pinned lower-center on every beat, forming a chant rhythm; 2) Cut hard between wide dense crowd shots and 60-90%-frame single-character close-ups; 3) Two-color scene logic: purple night + string lights vs teal/cream day interior; 4) Repeat an identical composition (HUSS! + angry red-cap close-up) as a visual chorus; 5) End on a white rounded card with plain black text as the deadpan punchline
